caption: The drawing depicts a single, ornate container with a lid, rendered primarily in shades of blue. The container is spherical in shape with a slightly flattened bottom, and three rows of rounded, bead-like protrusions encircle the body of the vessel. The lid fits snuggly atop the container and is similarly adorned with a pattern of rounded protrusions. The upper edge of the vessel features evenly spaced vertical columns, and the lid is topped with a conical, faceted finial. The background is a plain, light beige color, and the name "Stewart" is written in blue near the bottom right of the container.
title: Sugar Bowl
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
